answer: The island cap is checked at intake and jetty makes public the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a willow tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
